prospective_guards: Reconstruct and rehash the exact accepted manifest/runtime/JDK inputs used by the accepted verify-only original.
Require the exact manifest SHA-256 immediately before the allocate invocation.
Require the fixed ledger directory not to exist before allocation; an existing or partial cell blocks before SecureRandom is invoked.
Require no D2 development journal and no D2 process-run claim before allocation.
Invoke exactly one CLI operation named allocate; never invoke run-one in the allocation workflow.
The production allocator must first durably create ALLOCATION_INTENT.json, then invoke SecureRandom exactly for the 48 declared streams, then durably create ledger.json.
Require the resulting ledger schema, cell id, manifest SHA-256, allocation row order, row count and 48-stream global uniqueness through the existing validateFerocityDevelopmentLedger boundary.
Preserve the exact ledger bytes and SHA-256 from the first original whether allocation succeeds or records an allocation failure.
No retry, reroll, replacement allocation directory, alternate entropy source or second allocation original is authorized.
postconditions_if_clean: CLI emits LEDGER_DURABLE_NO_GAME and one ledger SHA-256.
Exactly 16 fixed allocation rows and 48 pairwise-distinct Long streams are present.
ALLOCATION_INTENT.json and ledger.json exist at the single fixed path and bind the accepted manifest.
No development trial claim, journal, supervisor run claim, GameInitializer call, gameplay or outcome exposure occurs.
Allocation authority is limited to the exact durable ledger; each future run-one remains a separate prospective claim/game gate.
failure_preservation: If stream generation or validation fails after ALLOCATION_INTENT creation, preserve ALLOCATION_FAILURE.json and any ledger bytes exactly.
A failed or collided allocation is consumed and must not be rerolled or replaced.
explicit_non_authority: This plan does not itself consume entropy.
No run-one claim, game initialization, gameplay, outcome interpretation, evaluation or confirmation authority.
next_gate: Independently review this exact one-time allocation plan against the accepted manifest and production allocator. If accepted, implement one source-bound allocation workflow and independently review its exact bytes before dispatch.
